sampling: 50% FSC147, 25% VisDrone, 25% UA-DETRAC; shuffled cycles with full eligible coverage per balanced epoch
dense_training_policy: Same explicit seven-image exclusion as A1 v1; frozen source manifests and full validation retained.
budget_note: Student starts from official weights; same source schedule and 12174 updates as A1/A2. Frozen A1-best teacher uses existing source-only training; its upstream cost is additional and explicitly recorded. Batch 2 x accumulation 4; per-image objective. 9 GiB allocator cap plus CUDA overhead targets approximately 10 GiB total.

occlusion.policy: Vehicle box sources only; FSC147 point-only unchanged; preserve all labels/counts; no object copy-paste. Protect heavy naturally occluded boxes, cap partial/unknown boxes. Geometry proxy, not actual pixel visibility guarantee.

spatial.teacher: fixed A1 source-validation-best; eval, no_grad, no EMA; encoder-only clean features
spatial.teacher_reliability: No per-instance confidence gating in v1; conservative fixed feature weight, true source supervision remains primary.
spatial.insertion: encoder output before both proposal selection and decoder; no GT or occlusion mask in model forward
